notes: Uses dne's monthly news sitemaps (https://dnes.dir.bg/sitemaps/2026/9/news.xml and /2026/10/news.xml) fetched via polite_fetch, parses <loc> and <lastmod>, filters to 2026-09-25..2026-10-25, dedupes, writes TSV at data/urls_custom/dir-bg.tsv, prints per‑day counts. Tested fetch of sample article gave >1500 chars and published date matching sitemap date within 1 day.
